ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio, approximately 0.20:0.80 white to black pixel distribution across visible ventral regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white mottling and speckling localized along the trailing edge and distal tips; the main body of the lobes is dominated by low-intensity black/dark grey pixels.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrations with low frequency and variable pixel-amplitude visible along the continuous boundary of both the left and right lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory extending outward to elevated terminal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast white pixel clusters densely concentrated at the terminal tips of both lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization patterns.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced white calcareous-like buildup or scarring at the distal tips of the fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: The central notch and peduncle area are occluded by turbulent water and spray.
